ddl:
-- ClickHouse-native DDL for the textbench OTel logs dataset.
--
-- Derived from the OpenSearch textbench index mapping (textbench/index.json).
-- Source corpus: ClickHouse/TextBench 1B OTel-shaped log records.
--
-- Field mapping (OS -> CH):
--   Timestamp           date_nanos     -> DateTime64(9)
--   TraceId, SpanId     keyword        -> String
--   TraceFlags          byte           -> Int8
--   SeverityText        keyword        -> String
--   SeverityNumber      byte           -> Int8
--   ServiceName         keyword        -> LowCardinality(String)  -- small cardinality helper
--   Body                text           -> String
--   Resource/Scope/Log Attributes  flat_object -> Map(String, String)
--   ResourceSchemaUrl / ScopeSchemaUrl / ScopeName / ScopeVersion  keyword -> String
--
-- IMPORTANT semantic differences from the OS textbench procedure:
-- The OS workload uses PPL `match(Body, 'tok1 tok2 ...')` which triggers
-- BM25-scored full-text search with standard tokenization. ClickHouse has
-- no BM25; we substitute:
--   match(Body, 'single tok') -> positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'tok') > 0
--   match(Body, 'a OR b OR c OR ...') -> multiSearchAny with
--     token needles (returns 0/1, not a relevance score)
--   match(Body, 'a') and match(Body, 'b') -> conjunction of
--     positionCaseInsensitive checks
-- This trades scoring fidelity for a syntactically clean SQL translation.
-- Result counts differ slightly from OS because CH substring-matching is
-- not token-aware (e.g. 'timeout' matches 'timeouts' in CH but not in OS
-- with a standard tokenizer). This is documented in the operations file
-- header and is acceptable for v1 latency/throughput measurement.
--
-- Ordering: (ServiceName, Timestamp) matches the OS `index.sort.field`
-- of [ServiceName, Timestamp] so query filters on ServiceName and
-- Timestamp ranges hit contiguous parts.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS textbench
(
    Timestamp DateTime64(9) NOT NULL,
    TraceId String DEFAULT '',
    SpanId String DEFAULT '',
    TraceFlags Int8 DEFAULT 0,
    SeverityText String DEFAULT '',
    SeverityNumber Int8 DEFAULT 0,
    ServiceName LowCardinality(String) DEFAULT '',
    Body String DEFAULT '',
    ResourceSchemaUrl String DEFAULT '',
    ResourceAttributes Map(String, String) DEFAULT map(),
    ScopeSchemaUrl String DEFAULT '',
    ScopeName String DEFAULT '',
    ScopeVersion String DEFAULT '',
    ScopeAttributes Map(String, String) DEFAULT map(),
    LogAttributes Map(String, String) DEFAULT map()
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (ServiceName, Timestamp);
